lead_independence.lead: Emaad Mir, 27, of Hallandale Beach was arrested on Aug. 8 after he allegedly traveled to Indian River County to meet a 14-year-old. article_framing_rejections.headline: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast caring for over 100 animals from Martin County hoarding cases

lead_independence.headline: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast caring for over 100 animals from Martin County hoarding cases
lead_independence.lead: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast in Palm City is caring for over 100 animals rescued from two separate hoarding investigations in Stuart and Palm City. One case involved 108 cats and dogs rescued from a Stuart home owned by 77-year-old Gail Giustino. Deputies found horrific conditions at Giustino's home on Southwest Meadowlark Circle in July, with no working air conditioning, little ventilation and up to a foot of animal feces covering the floor.
